title: Roman numerals
skill: Name the error for each bad input

good: In src/roman.js, make toRoman(n) and fromRoman(s) strict. toRoman: if n is not an integer (string, NaN, 3.5, Infinity, null) throw TypeError; check that first; then an integer below 1 or above 3999 throws RangeError; keep the subtractive forms (IV, IX, XL, XC, CD, CM). fromRoman: a non-string throws TypeError; accept only the exact string toRoman returns for some n in 1-3999, uppercase only; anything else ("IIII", "VV", "IC", "MMMM", "iv", "") throws TypeError, not RangeError. Do not change other files. Then run: node --test test/*.test.js
lazy: Add input validation to the roman numeral functions.
